title: Water
status: draft: written 19 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 1 Environmental Activities; not yet checked by a CBC Environmental Activities teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child names sources of water near home and school and lists uses of water.
representations: pictures of a river, well, borehole, tap, tank
a bucket under the roof when it rains
steps: Say what we use water for.

board.do: Draw a river, a tap, a well and rain.

board.say: Is this a source of water?

board.do: Wait for the child to say yes and how to collect it.
Write one use of water beside each source.

misconceptions.ask: Where does tap water come from?
misconceptions.repair: Follow a pipe from the tap to a tank in the school.

misconceptions.ask: Is rain a source of water?
misconceptions.repair: Put a bucket under the roof when it rains. See the water collected.

misconceptions.ask: Name another use of water apart from drinking.
misconceptions.repair: List with the class everything water did for them today.

listen_for: No, sources are rivers and lakes
misconceptions.ask: Is a well a source of water?
misconceptions.repair: Show a picture of a well and a spring near a village.

checks.question: Name a use of water at school.
